entities.name: Nykthos
entities.description: A sacred shrine atop Mount Carian and also the first Nyxborn artisan, formed by Kruphix.

entities.name: Nykthos (Nyxborn)
entities.description: The first Nyxborn divine artisan, formed by Kruphix to craft altars, later murdered on the Four Winds Plateau.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The starry realm of the gods.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of horizons who formed Nykthos.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr ascended to godhood who held the Great Revel at Nyx's Nykthos and was slain by Elspeth. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who slew Xenagos and was killed by Heliod. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who confronted Xenagos. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The goddess who aided the heroes.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who betrayed and killed his champion Elspeth.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: The god-forged blade Elspeth used to slay Xenagos.

entities.name: Mount Carian
entities.description: The summit crowned by the shrine, in the Oraniad Mountains.

events.summary: Kruphix forms the Nyxborn Nykthos as the first divine artisan; his greatest work is the Shrine to Nyx.
events.quote: the Nyxborn known as Nykthos was formed by Kruphix , the god of horizons, as the first divine artisan

events.summary: Nykthos is murdered on the Four Winds Plateau.
events.quote: He was later murdered on the Four Winds Plateau

events.summary: Elspeth and Ajani, aided by Nylea, confront Xenagos at the Nyx Nykthos; Elspeth slays him with Godsend.
events.quote: Elspeth slew Xenagos with the god-forged blade Godsend

events.summary: Heliod betrays and kills his champion Elspeth within Nykthos.
events.quote: Heliod , driven by pride, betrayed his champion.

relations.note: Formed him as first divine artisan.

relations.quote: Elspeth slew Xenagos with the god-forged blade Godsend
he struck Elspeth down, killing her as a final act of divine preservation
